Sandbox_TheWhisperers_Enabled_tooltip: Turn the Whisperer camouflage, noise meter and gore misery on or off.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MinGorePercent_too: How much of the body (skin and worn clothing) must be bloodied before zombies can be fooled.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_FullGorePercent_to: Gore level at which the camouflage reaches full strength.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MeterRiseRate_tool: Maximum meter increase per second, in percent. Lower values make the meter slower and zombie behaviour steadier.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MeterFallRate_tool: Meter decrease per second, in percent, once you are quiet. Dead-skin cover makes it faster.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MeterFallDelay_too: Seconds of quiet before the meter starts to fall.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MeterZombieRadius_: The meter only rises while a zombie is within this many tiles. With none that close, it falls whatever you do.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_UprightStillLevel_: Meter level you drift toward while standing still without sneaking. Above 50 attracts nearby zombies.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_UprightWalkLevel_t: Meter level you drift toward while walking without sneaking.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_DisguisedStillLeve: Standing level at full camouflage in both a dead-skin mask and suit. Partial disguises fall between this and the normal level.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_DisguisedWalkLevel: Walking level at full camouflage in both a dead-skin mask and suit. Partial disguises fall between this and the normal level.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_DisguisedRunLevel_: Running level at full camouflage in both a dead-skin mask and suit. Partial disguises fall between this and the normal level.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_DisguisedSprintLev: Sprinting level at full camouflage in both a dead-skin mask and suit. Partial disguises fall between this and the normal level.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_RunLevel_tooltip: Meter level you drift toward while running.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SprintLevel_toolti: Meter level you drift toward while sprinting or sitting in a vehicle with the engine running.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SneakMoveLevel_too: Meter level you drift toward while moving crouched. Standing still crouched is always 0.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MeleeNoise_tooltip: How much each melee swing pushes the meter up. 20 or more is never muffled by gore.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_NoiseMultiplier_to: Scales how much attacks, gunshots and other noises push the meter up.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_AttractRadiusMin_t: Tiles. Radius in which zombies notice you when the meter just passes half.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_AttractRadiusMax_t: Tiles. Radius in which zombies notice you just before the meter is full.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_FullAlertRadius_to: Tiles. When the meter is full, every zombie within this radius comes for you.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_InterestHalfLife_t: Once the meter drops below half, zombies already after you give up over time: half of them within this many seconds just under half, faster as the meter falls (a quarter of this at 0%%).
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_UnhappinessPerHour: Percent of maximum unhappiness gained per in-game hour while any blood remains on you, your clothes or your weapons.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_UnhappinessCap_too: Gore will not push unhappiness above this percent.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_StressPerHour_tool: Percent of maximum stress gained per in-game hour while bloodied.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_StressCap_tooltip: Gore will not push stress above this percent.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_DiscomfortLevel_to: Discomfort is held at least this high while bloodied.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsWeight_tooltip: Weight of one fresh gut. Guts lose weight as they rot.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsHalfLifeHours_: In-game hours for guts to lose half their weight and smearing capacity. After two half-lives a quarter is left, and so on. Guts below 5%% rot away.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsBaseYield_tool: Guts from butchering a corpse at Butchering 0.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsCoveragePerIte: How much blood one fresh gut can spread over every body part, before smearing losses.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsSmearEfficienc: Share of a gut that ends up on you when smeared. The rest is wasted.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsCarryThreshold: Carrying more guts than this is uncomfortable and sickening.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsCarrySicknessP: Percent of maximum sickness per in-game hour from carrying too many guts (full rate at 10 kg over the threshold).
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GutsCarryDiscomfor: Discomfort is held at least this high while carrying too many guts.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_CorpseSicknessPerH: Percent of maximum sickness per in-game hour with guts smeared over your whole body. Scales with how much of you is covered; washing the blood off stops it.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_CorpseSicknessCap_: Guts will not push sickness above this percent.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_HeadBlowsLongBlade: Chops needed to take a head with a machete or similar (one fewer per 3 Butchering levels, minimum 2). Swords and katanas always take one blow.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_HeadBlowsAxe_toolt: Chops needed to take a head with an axe (one fewer per 3 Butchering levels, minimum 2).
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_HeadStabsShortBlad: Stabs needed to take a head with a knife (one fewer per Butchering level, minimum 8).
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_ShortBladeEnduranc: Endurance spent per stab when taking a head with a short blade. Chopping costs a quarter of this per blow.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_FaceCutBaseTime_to: Time to cut a face off at Butchering 0 with a sharp blade. Skill and sharpness shorten it; dull blades lengthen it.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GearDryHalfLifeHou: In-game hours for an untreated face mask or skin suit to lose half its condition, carried or not. It crumbles below 5%%.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_GearTreatHours_too: In-game hours a face mask or skin suit treated with brain tan stops drying out.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_ZombieBrainSicknes: Food sickness from eating a zombie's brain, on top of the Knox infection it carries (which follows the Transmission setting).
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_PlayerBrainMinSkil: Eating a player's brain teaches the skills they had at this level or higher.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_PlayerBrainLevels_: Levels gained in each of those skills (never past 10). 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_HeadStakeBreakChan: Percent chance each part (the head, the stick) breaks when a head stake is disassembled.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MaskStealthMultipl: Multiplies your gore while an intact face mask is worn.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitStealthMultipl: Multiplies your gore while an intact skin suit is worn.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MaskCover_tooltip: Share of the full disguise an intact face mask gives. Cover lowers the meter, speeds its fall, muffles noise and raises the level at which zombies notice you.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitCover_tooltip: Share of the full disguise an intact skin suit gives. Mask and suit cover add up, to at most 100%%.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_CoverFallBoost_too: How many times faster the meter falls at full cover. It grows with the square of cover, so a suit settles almost at once and a mask much less so.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_CoverNoticeBonus_t: Points added to the 50%% notice level at full cover. At 40, zombies only notice a fully disguised player at 90%%.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MaskVisionBlur_too: How blurry the world looks past arm's reach while a face mask is worn. 0 turns the blur off.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MaskClearRadius_to: Tiles around you that stay sharp while a face mask is worn.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_ZombieMannerisms_t: In an intact face mask and skin suit together, you stand, walk, run, sprint and sit on the ground like a zombie, at a zombie's pace. Crouching shambles slowly. Either piece alone leaves you moving as a human.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_WearToggleDamage_t: Condition lost each time a face mask or skin suit is put on or taken off.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_WearDamagePerHour_: Condition lost per in-game hour while a mask or suit is worn.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_BreakChancePerHour: Base chance per in-game hour that worn dead skin tears apart. Rises sharply as it wears down.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_NailDamage_tooltip: Condition lost when a mask or suit is sewn (or repaired) with a nail instead of a needle.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_MaskRepairTailorin: Tailoring level needed to repair a face mask.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitTailoring_tool: Tailoring level needed to make a skin suit.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitButchering_too: Butchering level needed to make a skin suit.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitHitDestroyDama: A single hit doing at least this much damage tears a worn skin suit apart.
Sandbox_TheWhisperers_SuitHitConditionLo: Suit condition percent lost per point of damage from smaller hits.
